description: This PHP source file is a controller class for managing banners within the OpenCart admin panel. It handles tasks such as listing banners, rendering forms for creation and editing, saving banner data, and bulk operations like enabling, disabling, and deleting banners.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner CRUD operations in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point, prepares data and renders the banner list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the current list of banners by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares banner list data, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a banner.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of banner data, either creating or updating.
